title: Power Rankings: Bucks, Wiz, Clips streak up charts
heading: 2005-06 Power Rankings: Week 1

rankings.summaryHtml: Spurs are such heavy title favorites that one loss can't drop 'em. But as Brent Barry notes: ''I guess we can put to rest all those rumors about us going undefeated.''
